insight: Raised $48M from Sequoia and Kleiner Perkins, plus a strategic investment from American Express's Amex Ventures.
name: Traversal
tagline: An autonomous AI SRE that triages alerts and finds root causes in minutes.
description: Traversal is an AI site reliability engineer (SRE) that autonomously triages noisy alerts, traces incidents across services and dependencies to isolate root causes, and feeds production context back to prevent recurrence. Its causal search engine and 'production world model' narrow failures down at petabyte scale. At American Express it reached 82% root-cause accuracy and cut potential MTTR by ~32%, with PepsiCo also among its enterprise users.
edge: A purpose-built AI SRE: its causal search engine traces root cause across services in minutes at petabyte scale, beyond dashboards or LLM chat-over-logs.
pros: Feeds production context to prevent recurrence
